first.rationale: Competitor entry pricing creates an immediate threat in the price-sensitive SMB segment, where targeted promotional pricing previously showed strong acquisition and revenue lift. The prior pricing result pooled cohorts after a mid-test redefinition, so memory_73 should be verified before committing. Pricing can create margin, discount-expectation, and customer-quality risks; use a targeted, time-bounded experiment rather than a broad rollout. Onboarding is also deteriorating, so memory_86 is the second verification priority to assess whether the more durable adoption lever should supersede pricing.
